evidence.observation: Smooth, monotonic warming profile along column, consistent gradient reboiler-to-condenser
Reflux and distillate flows steady ~0.3 L/h with ratio ~6-7; brief single-sample blip in FT704 at k=19
Pressure ~448 mbar and dP stable, no flooding or blockage signature

args.missing_evidence: A distillate composition measurement (GC/analytical sample) to judge separation; continued flow trend to confirm the k=19 FT704 spike was noise.
